summary.text: Nate Willems is the Democratic nominee for Attorney General. A labor and employment lawyer from Mount Vernon, he served in the Iowa House from 2009 to 2013; his campaign says that for nearly two decades he has represented workers owed pay.

paragraphs.text: Earned a bachelor's degree from Georgetown University and a J.D. from the University of Iowa.
Labor lawyer and partner at Rush & Nicholson, P.L.C.; executive board member of the Hawkeye Area Labor Council, AFL-CIO.
Served in the Iowa House of Representatives, District 29, 2009-2013.
